episodes.program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (reduce (lambda (acc color)
                   (let* ((dots (find-color g color)))
                     (if (< (length dots) 2)
                         acc
                         (reduce (lambda (a d1)
                                   (reduce (lambda (a2 d2)
                                             (if (<= (fst d2) (fst d1))
                                                 a2
                                                 (let* ((dr (- (fst d2) (fst d1)))
                                                        (dc (- (snd d2) (snd d1))))
                                                   (if (= (abs dr) (abs dc))
                                                       (let* ((sr (if (> dr 0) 1 -1))
                                                              (sc (if (> dc 0) 1 -1)))
                                                         (reduce (lambda (a3 k)
                                                                   (set-cell a3
                                                                             (+ (fst d1)
                                                                                (* k sr))
                                                                             (+ (snd d1)
                                                                                (* k sc))
                                                                             color))
                                                                 a2
                                                                 (range 0
                                                                        (+ (abs dr) 1))))
                                                       a2))))
                                           a
                                           dots))
                                 acc
                                 dots))))
                 g
                 (range 1 10))))

episodes.program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (reduce (lambda (acc color)
    (let ((dots (find-color g color)))
      (if (< (length dots) 2)
          acc
          (reduce (lambda (a d1)
            (reduce (lambda (a2 d2)
              (if (or (> (fst d2) (fst d1))
                      (and (= (fst d2) (fst d1)) (> (snd d2) (snd d1))))
                  (let* ((dr (- (fst d2) (fst d1)))
                         (dc (- (snd d2) (snd d1))))
                    (if (or (= dr 0) (= dc 0))
                        (let* ((steps (if (= dr 0) (abs dc) (abs dr)))
                               (sr (if (= dr 0) 0 (if (> dr 0) 1 -1)))
                               (sc (if (= dc 0) 0 (if (> dc 0) 1 -1))))
                          (reduce (lambda (a3 k)
                            (set-cell a3
                                      (+ (fst d1) (* k sr))
                                      (+ (snd d1) (* k sc))
                                      color))
                            a2
                            (range 0 (+ steps 1))))
                        a2))
                  a2))
              a
              dots))
            acc
            dots))))
    g
    (range 1 10))))
